subject: Cloud connector roadmap: gating, billing hooks, and SI onboarding
messages:

Subject: Connector partnership: marketplace gating + billing webhooks

Hi Diego / Marissa,

Thanks again for the quick intro call last week. CloudPact is moving forward on a marketplace-driven distribution push and we want to make sure the Redwood connector fits both the listing criteria and our billing hooks model. I'm attaching our latest Marketplace App Acceptance Playbook (MAAP) so you can see the gating expectations and the billing events we need emitted for downstream invoicing.

High-level asks:
- Confirm whether Redwood can emit both per-token usage events and invoice-level webhooks (invoice_created / invoice_paid).
- Clarify what metadata will be available in the events (customer_id, plan_id, usage_delta, invoice_id).
- Understand listing gating: SSO, SOC2 evidence, support SLA, and private-offer support.

Can we set a short cross-functional sync next week (30 min) so product/engineering/partner ops can align? Daniel Ruiz (partners) will join from our side.

Attachments: CloudPact_MAAP_v2.pdf (spec)

Thanks,
Daniel Ruiz

Diego here — quick clarifying questions before we schedule:
1) When you say "per-token usage events" do you expect a continuous stream of individual token events or batched usage deltas (preferred)?
2) Is CloudPact requiring a marketplace-controlled billing flow (i.e., charges mediated by CloudPact with webhook notifications) or will Redwood invoice directly and only send usage events for reconciliation?

If you can give a short preference on those two, I can pull in Marissa and Karthik to scope impacts. I'm available most mornings next week.

— Diego
Diego Fernandez
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Connector partnership: marketplace gating + billing webhooks

Thanks for the spec, Daniel — reviewed and added a few product asks / constraints so we can scope correctly. Attaching a short billing webhook worksheet (connector-billing-spec.xlsx) and a Drive link with the MAAP highlights.

Key product notes / asks (high level):
- Billing event model: prefer batched usage deltas (periodic pushes) rather than per-token events. We can support near-real-time (minutes) batches for high-volume customers.
- Required event fields: customer_id, redwood_account_id, plan_id, usage_delta (tokens), period_start / period_end, invoice_id (when available), currency, region_tag.
- Marketplace billing flows supported:
  * Marketplace-mediated billing (CloudPact invoices customer, Redwood emits usage events + invoice reconciliation webhooks) — preferred for private-offers.
  * Direct billing (Redwood invoices) with usage export for CloudPact reconciliation.
- Gating checklist we need to satisfy for listing:
  * SOC2 or equivalent evidence (attestation PDF)
  * SSO (SAML/OIDC) and SCIM provisioning for user mapping
  * Support SLOs and escalation contacts for Marketplace listing page
  * Data residency flags in listing metadata (region filter)
- Integration/engineering asks:
  * Provide open schema for webhook payloads (JSON) + retry semantics (exponential backoff, idempotency keys).
  * Option to sign webhooks (HMAC) for verification.
  * A sandbox/testing endpoint for partner verification before going live.

Timeline constraints: product wants to avoid ad-hoc one-off connectors. If CloudPact requires non-standard billing fields or very different webhook semantics, we will need an exception request and a dedicated engineering sprint (est ~4–6 weeks).

Next steps I propose:
1) Daniel — confirm preferred billing flow (marketplace-mediated vs direct billing) and whether private-offer support is required.
2) Diego — if private-offer mandatory, can partner ops provide details on contract flow?
3) Karthik — please provide a rough engineering estimate after Daniel confirms (can you aim for an initial estimate by 2027-04-29?).

Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2B3cDEfGhIJkL
Attachment: connector-billing-spec.xlsx

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Product Manager, Marketplace Integrations

Subject: Re: Connector partnership: marketplace gating + billing webhooks

Looping in SaaSify (we're the SI helping CloudPact with onboarding at scale). A couple of practical notes from SI/Customer side:
- SSO: customers expect Okta + Azure AD support day one; SCIM for provisioning is a must for enterprise buyers.
- Procurement: many customers route Marketplace purchases through PO + private-offer workflows. If you require Redwood to invoice directly, it adds additional reconciliations for the SI. Marketplace-mediated billing is strongly preferred for CloudPact customers.
- Compliance: CloudPact buyers will require either Redwood SOC2 report or an attestation letter — if Redwood has a subprocessor list and data-flow diagram that will speed review.
- Timeline: target pilot in Q3 (July) ideally — gives us time to validate sandbox flows and run 3 pilot customers.

Happy to jump on a technical details call with Karthik and your eng team.

Best,
Asha Rao
Director, Integrations — SaaSify Solutions
asha@saasify.io
